title: Ravens GM Eric DeCosta: Nnamdi Madubuike's status doesn't affect much about draft plans

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens GM Eric DeCosta: Nnamdi Madubuike's status doesn't affect much about draft plans
sources.description: Reports last month indicated that the Ravens have increased optimism about defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike will be able to return from the neck injury that kept him out for the final 15 games last season, but the team has offered no concrete word about his outlook for the coming season.
